title: Day of year
statementMd:
Return which day of the year (1-366) the date falls on.

**Example:** `day_of_year(2023, 1, 1)` returns `1`.
hints: Add up the lengths of the previous months.
solutionMd:
```python
def day_of_year(year, month, day):
    leap = year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)
    lengths = [31, 29 if leap else 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    return sum(lengths[: month - 1]) + day
```

Slice the month lengths before the current month.
referenceSolution:
def day_of_year(year, month, day):
    leap = year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)
    lengths = [31, 29 if leap else 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    return sum(lengths[: month - 1]) + day
